$comment: The owner's attention schedule, schema_version 1. The single definition of the shape warte serves at GET <warte>/api/attention, the cache notice.py keeps of it (<store>/attention.cache.json, under config) and the local file ~/.config/pulseengine/attention.json. notice.py loads this file with the same validator as notice.schema.json and the same keyword limit. Before validation a window, available or focus entry written as the string HH:MM-HH:MM becomes {from, to} on every day. Rules a schema cannot express are enforced in notice.py: HH:MM times, from differs from to, max_asking_flows at most 100, a known timezone, off.to after off.from.

span.description: A daily time span in the schedule's timezone. to before from crosses midnight and belongs to the day it opened. days defaults to every day.

off.description: A period the owner is off (vacation, sick, a conference): nothing surfaces and nothing notifies; digests accumulate. ISO 8601 date-times; without an offset they are read in the schedule's timezone.

windows.description: Decision windows: the only times questions reach the owner.

available.description: Working hours. When given, a decision window counts only inside them.

focus.description: Focus blocks: no notification; the digest is still written.
